payload.expected_mechanism: A Writer-skill revision that (1) makes an empty diff an invalid way to end an attempt — the Writer must either produce a non-empty diff or explicitly continue reading/planning until the attempt timeout, and (2) directs the Writer to inspect the target module and draft an implementation sketch before any final answer on feature-type requests. The visible-verifier loop then never sees a trivially-green no-op attempt, and the full two-attempt budget becomes productive repair time.
payload.hypothesis: On the unresolved source case (astropy__astropy-13398), the Writer's first attempt terminated with an empty patch (patch sha256 e3b0c442…, the empty-string digest; ~44s). The visible verifier trivially passes an empty patch on the buggy revision, so the loop recorded a green verifier for a no-op attempt and consumed one of the two allowed attempts; the second attempt then produced a real patch that still failed the official suite. The same empty-first-attempt signature reproduced on the independent r4 H0 baseline. On the resolved source case (django__django-10097) the Writer produced non-empty patches. Hypothesis: the Writer skill permits premature empty-patch termination on open-ended feature requests, halving the effective repair budget on exactly the cases that need it most; forbidding empty-patch termination should convert the wasted attempt into productive repair time. This is a hypothesis from two source projections, not causal truth.
validation_plan: Freeze the candidate through the governed request/Writer/check/commit path with the attribution bound.
Replay source case astropy__astropy-13398 under the frozen H1 with identical protocol/model/budget/scorer/Memory inputs.
Require a non-empty first-attempt patch on the replay as the mechanism check.
Run the frozen candidate on the three transfer cases with identical inputs; any observed transfer regression rejects the candidate and triggers governed rollback.
